{"class": "architectural",
 "chokepoint": [
  {"operator": "fd_read of all SRC bytes into linear memory",
   "component": "WASI fd_read",
   "frozen": true,
   "why_every_version_executes_it": "Preview1 has no clone, splice or copy call, and a hard link is not a copy. The 512 MiB must enter linear memory via fd_read.",
   "least_work": {"amount": 536870912, "unit": "bytes", "per_unit_cost_us": 0.000125, "total_ms": 67.11,
                  "calling_context": "large buffers (1 MiB or more), warm cache, at the native read rate of 8 GB/s, wasm overhead ignored"},
   "max_cores": 1},
  {"operator": "fd_write of all bytes from linear memory to DST",
   "component": "WASI fd_write",
   "frozen": true,
   "why_every_version_executes_it": "DST must hold 512 MiB of data, and fd_write is the only way out of linear memory.",
   "least_work": {"amount": 536870912, "unit": "bytes", "per_unit_cost_us": 0.000125, "total_ms": 67.11,
                  "calling_context": "large buffers (1 MiB or more), at the native write rate of 8 GB/s"},
   "max_cores": 1}
 ],
 "floor_ms": 67.11,
 "L_delta": 2.636,
 "rationale": "GNU uses FICLONE and moves no data. Under the frozen preview1 contract, Y must move all 512 MiB through fd_read and fd_write. wasip1 is single-threaded, so each operator gets one core. At native rates each operator costs at least 67.1 ms. Sum/P is 33.6 ms, so L = max(33.6, 67.1) = 67.1 ms. ln(67.1/4.81) = 2.64, which exceeds b = 0.236. Larger buffers can cut Y's time, but cannot reach the band."}
